lead: North Dakota plumbing is built for extreme cold, deep frost and river flooding. PipeMend sends licensed local plumbers from Fargo to Bismarck.
risk: frozen pipes and water lines, flooded basements and hard water
risk_short: frozen pipes, flooding and hard water
why: North Dakota winters are long and severe, so water lines must be buried deep, and exposed or shallow lines freeze. Many homes have basements.
The Red River floods Fargo and Grand Forks in some springs, and hard water is common. The North Dakota State Plumbing Board licenses plumbers.
tips: Keep the heat on and cabinets open in deep cold.
Test your sump pump before spring thaw.
areas: Calls come from Fargo, Bismarck, Grand Forks, Minot, West Fargo, Williston and rural North Dakota.

faq.q: Who licenses plumbers in North Dakota?
faq.a: The North Dakota State Plumbing Board licenses plumbers. Check the license before work starts.
